creative_direction: Draw Dorami with her familiar yellow body, white face, red bow, and small neck bell. She faces the viewer with a slight head tilt and an easy smile, her round hands resting low at the sides. Keep the iris motifs modest within the original white eye areas. Use a pale butter-blue background with clear cel shadows, avoiding gadgets, letters, or altered robot proportions. Use clear cel shading with small handmade variations in the contours and a simple backdrop. Give both irises gentle crimson color with three small black tomoe around visible pupils. Keep the pattern inside the irises, with clear highlights and a friendly gaze. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
